name: detect an opponent four-in-a-row threat and block it
definition: identify a row pattern of the opponent's stones that can form a line and pick an end intersection adjacent to that run to block it.
failure_mode: any other cell, even a valid empty one, fails the check.

name: detect erroneous marker messages in event fields
definition: Recognize when an event field contains any of a set of case-insensitive error substrings and keep those records while marking them for evaluation.
failure_mode: Mis-detecting or dropping error events leads to wrong denominator counts.
